required_assumptions: p and q are distinct symbolic variables
p - q is nonzero in the expression domain
s is an uninterpreted unary function
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog members are explained by a single univariate latent function s(z). G0002 and G0003 are direct evaluations at p and q; G0001 is the same evaluations combined in the symmetric rational form (s(p)+s(q))/(p-q). This is a structural algebraic relation, not a physical one.
